fact: Former Egypt Post chairperson Essam El-Sagheer says Egypt Post has completed applying a new 7-digit postcode per group of buildings, built on CAPMAS data and made available to DHL to look up addresses, though cooperation to activate it is still to come.
Former Egypt Post chairperson Essam El-Sagheer says the new postcode system has been applied across the country.

Egypt's MCIT said about 19 million national real estate identification numbers had been issued across several governorates, while the digital system to manage them was still being developed ahead of its launch.
